purpose: Frozen preregistration skeleton for the confirmatory funding-conditioned-volatility path (FCLR-014). Created and frozen BEFORE any outcome inspection. Zero outcome values inspected. A >=3-block admissible panel resume trigger is required before this skeleton can be materialized into a run.
repo_priority: Track C funding-conditioned volatility first (repo name: Funding-conditioned-volatility-and-liquidation-risk). Track A structurally blocked — no probing/scans/wrappers. Track B H003 COMPLETE_INCONCLUSIVE — do not merge tracks.

hypotheses.description: Funding extremes + realized volatility + pre-specified price-dislocation/smoothing features improve out-of-sample forecasts of future realized volatility/stress vs RV-only baseline
hypotheses.direction: C2 vs B1: lower out-of-sample QLIKE on next-24-hour realized variance of mark-price returns

hypotheses.description: Independent reconstruction of Shek (2026) funding-correction pattern from admissible public data; correction time distinct from volatility forecast and from liquidation outcomes

universe.symbol_scope: venue-native archival coverage from public local archives; current survivors alone are not a valid historical universe; no market-cap ranking dependency
universe.period_source: Binance public archive (data.binance.vision / binance-public-data), unauthenticated; klines 1h, fundingRate, indexPriceKlines, markPriceKlines, premiumIndexKlines

admissibility_source_rules: No authentication, payment, paid trial/plan, account registration, personal API keys, manual downloads, user-provided files, or human approval for ordinary research.
No bypass of access controls, regional restrictions, rate limits, or usage terms; no requester-pays archive in core pipeline.
Provenance-auditable URLs/ETags/checksums; schema, license/terms, coverage, gaps recorded per source.

Separate Track A (observed liquidation labels), Track B (modeled hypothetical boundary breaches), Track C (volatility/stress outcomes); never merge or conflate; observed/modeled/synthetic labels kept distinct.
No live/paper trading, order endpoints, credentials, or account operations.

unit_timing.unit: one eligible linear perpetual contract x one fully closed UTC hourly timestamp
unit_timing.forecast_timestamp_t: immediately after all data for closed hour t available; every input available by that instant
unit_timing.outcomes_begin: next hourly interval t+1; no same-bar or future data in predictors
unit_timing.funding_availability: latest funding observation with availability timestamp no later than t, retaining sign and source cadence

targets.primary: next-24-hour realized variance of mark-price returns: sum of squared log returns over next 24 complete hourly intervals, t+1 through t+24
targets.secondary_note: explicitly secondary; every tested horizon/model/feature comparison included in declared multiplicity family; no promotion of a secondary horizon because it performs better
targets.boundary_breach_target: Track B modeled hypothetical long/short liquidation boundary breach only under pre-registered margin/leverage assumptions; NOT observed liquidations; not used for Track C confirmatory claim

features.causal_rule: computed per contract from data ending no later than t; train-only normalization, quantile thresholds, standardization; missing features remain missing (no zero-fill/forward-fill)
funding: absolute funding rate |funding| as distinct feature
trailing funding percentile vs preceding 90 calendar days (>=30 valid historical funding observations required; record actual count)
time-to-next-funding only where knowable at prediction time
realized_volatility: RV1h, RV24h, RV168h trailing realized variances from hourly mark-price log returns
price_dislocation_smoothing: perpetual premium vs index (mark/index - 1, valid contemporaneous alignment under frozen tolerance)
mark/EMA24 distance (mark price / 24h EMA - 1; EMA from prior/current fully closed bars only)
lagged price changes only if explicit and available at forecast time
features.no_invented_delay: no direct price-delay measurement; mark/index premium and EMA distance are observable dislocation proxies only

splits.rule: chronological train/validation/test partitions in time order; boundaries from data coverage only, frozen before outcomes; no random splits; unique UTC timestamps, not randomly sampled rows
splits.purge_embargo_rationale: registered secondary horizon extends to 168 hours; no target interval overlaps train/validation/test folds

candidate_frozen_splits_pending_panel.train: 2024-04-01T00:00:00Z .. 2024-06-08T23:00:00Z (FCLR-002 frozen train window; reuse only if panel admissible and re-audited)
candidate_frozen_splits_pending_panel.test: 2024-07-23T00:00:00Z .. 2024-09-30T23:00:00Z (70 days = 2 non-overlapping 30-day blocks — INSUFFICIENT for confirmatory; DO NOT use for confirmatory until >=3 blocks verified)
candidate_frozen_splits_pending_panel.note: Split boundaries above are illustrative/copy of FCLR-002; they are NOT frozen for FCLR-014 until a new admissible panel with >=3 non-overlapping 30-day OOS blocks is verified and boundaries re-recorded here before outcomes.

splits.block_requirement: >=3 non-overlapping 30-day OOS evaluation blocks (>=5 symbols paired panel); 70-day FCLR-002 test window = 2 blocks fails this rule

models_baselines.B0: persistence baseline: forecast next-24h realized variance using preceding RV24h
models_baselines.B1: RV-only baseline: fixed-form HAR-style OLS on log RV1h, log RV24h, log RV168h predicting log next-24h realized variance
models_baselines.C1: funding-augmented: B1 form + signed funding + past-only 90-day absolute-funding percentile
models_baselines.C2: combined candidate: B1 form + C1 features + mark/index premium + mark/EMA24 distance
models_baselines.fitting: OLS fixed-form log-linear regression; model log(RV + 1e-12) with epsilon fixed in advance; standardize predictor columns using training-only mean/std; zero-variance column handling frozen before outcomes; documented training-only smearing correction for back-transformation to strictly positive variance; no regularization, no model-family search, no hyperparameter tuning

primary_contrast: C2 versus B1 on paired out-of-sample test QLIKE (absolute difference and relative reduction)

uncertainty.method: block bootstrap resampling complete UTC time blocks jointly across instruments (preserves common market shocks and serial dependence)
uncertainty.diagnostics: instrument concentration sensitivity, leave-one-instrument-out, regime/time-block stability

multiplicity.method: Holm familywise-error correction across the whole declared family (all primary/secondary targets, feature ablations, thresholds, model versions, price-source arms, universe arms)
multiplicity.reporting: raw and adjusted results; every failed/not-run cell with reasons

decision_gates.data_gate: >=5 instruments in paired out-of-sample panel; >=3 non-overlapping 30-day OOS blocks; valid uncertainty estimation
decision_gates.practical_materiality: at least 2% relative reduction in primary QLIKE vs B1, pre-registered; smaller apparent gain does not pass unless a different justified threshold was frozen in advance
decision_gates.uncertainty_condition: two-sided uncertainty interval for paired loss difference supports improvement
decision_gates.multiplicity_condition: predeclared multiplicity rule passes after correction
decision_gates.concentration_condition: skill not dominated by one coin, one venue, one brief crisis, or one time block
decision_gates.calibration_condition: acceptable calibration for any event-probability forecast
decision_gates.leakage_condition: no unresolved leakage, source, label, or timestamp defect
decision_gates.forecast_gate: all conditions above required before any risk-overlay phase; otherwise retain NOT_SUPPORTED/INCONCLUSIVE/EXPLORATORY_ONLY

holdout_status: sealed final holdout not opened; cannot be treated as untouched evidence once inspected
resume_trigger: new unauthenticated, provenance-auditable Binance (or equivalently admissible public) panel with >=5 symbols and >=3 non-overlapping 30-day OOS blocks (or equivalent pre-registered design meeting claim-worthiness/block criteria), sufficient mark/index/funding/klines coverage and documented gaps; verify admissibility, freeze this preregistration, then build/evaluate; no sealed-holdout reuse, no threshold shopping
do_not: Do not inspect zero outcome values before this freeze is recorded
Do not promote exploratory results (FCLR-002 C2-vs-B1 +4.588% rel QLIKE, 2 blocks) to confirmatory
Do not relax the >=3-block rule after seeing outcomes
Do not threshold-shop or reuse sealed holdouts
Do not conflate Track C volatility outcomes with observed liquidations (Track A) or modeled boundary breaches (Track B)
Do not modify .github/workflows; no schedulers/pollers/controllers/wrappers; no status-only churn
